summary.zh: 查询公司卡消费与报销

description.zh: 读取公司卡交易、报销单与预算使用情况，可按商户或时间筛选。适合核对支出或准备月度汇总。首次连接在浏览器登录 Ramp 授权。
description.en: Read card transactions, reimbursement requests, and budget usage, filtered by merchant or date. Useful for checking spend or preparing a monthly summary. Sign in to Ramp in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Ramp 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Ramp and authorize on first connect
